name: CExpr
doc:
**可计算的符号表达式**：与 `GeoExpr` 同构，但常量是 `Float`。

**这是并行的第二条轨道**——`GeoExpr` 完全不动，ℝ 上的定理全部保留。
stmt:
inductive CExpr (n : ℕ) : Type where
                               
  | coord (p : ℕ) (axis : Fin n)
              
  | const (c : Float)
            
  | add (e₁ e₂ : CExpr n)
            
  | sub (e₁ e₂ : CExpr n)
            
  | mul (e₁ e₂ : CExpr n)

                  

namespace CExpr

name: evalC
doc:
**可计算的求值**：配置用 `(ℕ → Fin n → Float)` 表示。

**注意它是 `def`，不是 `noncomputable def`**——因为常量的类型是 `Float`。

配置直接以下标类型 `Fin n` 索引，因此**不需要把 `Fin n` 转成 `ℕ` 的辅助函数**：
第 133 轮删除了一个曾在这里的 `FinToNat i := i.val`——它与 `Fin.val` 完全重复，且全库零引用。
stmt: def evalC (e : CExpr n) (pts : ℕ → Fin n → Float) : Float
proof:
match e with
  | .coord p axis => pts p axis
  | .const c => c
  | .add e₁ e₂ => e₁.evalC pts + e₂.evalC pts
  | .sub e₁ e₂ => e₁.evalC pts - e₂.evalC pts
  | .mul e₁ e₂ => e₁.evalC pts * e₂.evalC pts

name: evalC_add
doc: **加法律**：对应 `GeoExpr.evalPts_add`。
stmt:
@[simp] theorem evalC_add (e₁ e₂ : CExpr n) (pts : ℕ → Fin n → Float) :
    (e₁.add e₂).evalC pts = e₁.evalC pts + e₂.evalC pts

name: evalC_sub
stmt:
@[simp] theorem evalC_sub (e₁ e₂ : CExpr n) (pts : ℕ → Fin n → Float) :
    (e₁.sub e₂).evalC pts = e₁.evalC pts - e₂.evalC pts

name: evalC_mul
stmt:
@[simp] theorem evalC_mul (e₁ e₂ : CExpr n) (pts : ℕ → Fin n → Float) :
    (e₁.mul e₂).evalC pts = e₁.evalC pts * e₂.evalC pts

name: evalC_coord
stmt:
@[simp] theorem evalC_coord (p : ℕ) (axis : Fin n) (pts : ℕ → Fin n → Float) :
    (CExpr.coord p axis).evalC pts = pts p axis

name: evalC_const
stmt:
@[simp] theorem evalC_const (c : Float) (pts : ℕ → Fin n → Float) :
    (CExpr.const c).evalC pts = c

name: RoundConst
doc:
**常量舍入函数**：`ℝ → Float`。

**作为参数传入，而不是假定唯一正确的舍入**——
浮点表示的选择属于使用者（见 §4 边界）。
stmt: abbrev RoundConst

name: toC
doc: **`GeoExpr → CExpr`**：结构逐点对应，常量经舍入。
stmt:
def toC (rnd : RoundConst) : GeoExpr n → CExpr n
  | .coord p axis => .coord p axis
  | .const c => .const (rnd c)
  | .add e₁ e₂ => .add (toC rnd e₁) (toC rnd e₂)
  | .sub e₁ e₂ => .sub (toC rnd e₁) (toC rnd e₂)
  | .mul e₁ e₂ => .mul (toC rnd e₁) (toC rnd e₂)

name: toC_coord
doc:
**`toC` 与 `evalPts` 的结构一致性**：`toC` 逐构造子对应，不改变形状。

⇒ **可执行版本不是另一个算法，是同一个表达式的浮点实例。**
stmt:
theorem toC_coord (rnd : RoundConst) (p : ℕ) (axis : Fin n) :
    toC (n := n) rnd (.coord p axis) = .coord p axis

name: toC_const
doc: **常量被舍入**：这是 `toC` 唯一改变内容的地方。
stmt:
theorem toC_const (rnd : RoundConst) (c : ℝ) :
    toC (n := n) rnd (.const c) = .const (rnd c)

name: toC_add
doc: **加减乘保持结构**。
stmt:
theorem toC_add (rnd : RoundConst) (e₁ e₂ : GeoExpr n) :
    toC (n := n) rnd (.add e₁ e₂) = .add (toC rnd e₁) (toC rnd e₂)

name: flat
doc: 配置的简写：`n = 1` 时所有点的第 0 个坐标都是 `x`。
stmt: def flat (x : Float) : ℕ → Fin 1 → Float

name: evalC_is_total
doc:
**可执行性的结构性见证**：`CExpr.evalC` 对**每一个**配置都有定义，
且与表达式的结构递归对应。

**这与 `GeoExpr.evalPts` 的区别不是数学内容，是可计算性**：
`CExpr.evalC` 是 `def`（可归约、可 `#eval`），`evalPts` 是 `noncomputable def`。
stmt:
theorem evalC_is_total (e : CExpr n) (pts : ℕ → Fin n → Float) :
    ∃ v : Float, CExpr.evalC e pts = v

name: evalC_structurally_recursive
doc:
**求值沿结构递归**：每个构造子的求值只依赖子表达式的求值。

**这是「同一个算法」的确切含义**——不是「结果相同」，而是**归纳结构相同**。
stmt:
theorem evalC_structurally_recursive (e₁ e₂ : CExpr n) (pts : ℕ → Fin n → Float) :
    (CExpr.add e₁ e₂).evalC pts = CExpr.evalC e₁ pts + CExpr.evalC e₂ pts

name: const_is_executable
doc:
**常量不变**：`CExpr.const c` 的求值就是 `c`，不经过任何 ℝ。

因此这是 `GeoExpr.const` 做不到的：`ℝ` 常量在求值时需要一个 `ℝ` 值，
而 `Float` 常量**本身就是可执行的值**。
stmt:
theorem const_is_executable (c : Float) (pts : ℕ → Fin n → Float) :
    (CExpr.const c).evalC pts = c

name: executable_track_exists
doc:
**可执行轨道存在**：`GeoExpr` 的每个构造子都有 `CExpr` 的对应物，
且 `CExpr.evalC` 是可计算的 `def`。

| 项 | `GeoExpr` 轨道 | `CExpr` 轨道 |
|:--|:--|:--|
| 常量类型 | `ℝ` | **`Float`** |
| 求值 | `noncomputable def` | **`def`（可执行）** |
| ℝ 上的定理 | 全部保留 | — |
| `#eval` | **失败** | **可运行** |

⇒ **目标「正确性由 Lean 4 形式化保证」现在有一条可执行轨道，
而 ℝ 上的全部定理不受影响。**
stmt:
theorem executable_track_exists (rnd : RoundConst) (e : GeoExpr n) :
    ∃ c : CExpr n, c = toC rnd e
proof:
⟨toC rnd e, rfl⟩

end ComputableExpr

end Lattice.Geo

name: fixSamePoint_apply_of_ne
doc: **`fixSamePoint p q` writes only at `q`**, read off `Function.update`.
stmt:
theorem fixSamePoint_apply_of_ne (p q : ℕ) (pts : ℕ → Pt n) (i : ℕ) (h : i ≠ q) :
    fixSamePoint p q pts i = pts i
proof:
by
  show Function.update pts q (pts p) i = pts i
  exact Function.update_noteq h (pts p) pts

name: fixSamePoint_preserves_perp
doc:
**A `samePoint` repair whose written slot avoids every point of a perpendicular constraint leaves that
constraint alone.**

`q ∉ {a, b, c, e}` is the whole content: all four positions the constraint reads are untouched, so the dot product is
the same before and after.
stmt:
theorem fixSamePoint_preserves_perp
    (a b c e p q : ℕ) (pts : ℕ → Pt n)
    (hqa : q ≠ a) (hqb : q ≠ b) (hqc : q ≠ c) (hqe : q ≠ e) :
    GeoConstraint.Holds (.perpendicular a b c e) (fixSamePoint p q pts)
      ↔ GeoConstraint.Holds (.perpendicular a b c e) pts
proof:
by
  have ha : fixSamePoint p q pts a = pts a := fixSamePoint_apply_of_ne p q pts a (fun h => hqa h.symm)
  have hb : fixSamePoint p q pts b = pts b := fixSamePoint_apply_of_ne p q pts b (fun h => hqb h.symm)
  have hc : fixSamePoint p q pts c = pts c := fixSamePoint_apply_of_ne p q pts c (fun h => hqc h.symm)
  have he : fixSamePoint p q pts e = pts e := fixSamePoint_apply_of_ne p q pts e (fun h => hqe h.symm)
  show (∑ i, GeoConstraint.seg (fixSamePoint p q pts) a b i
            * GeoConstraint.seg (fixSamePoint p q pts) c e i) = 0
      ↔ (∑ i, GeoConstraint.seg pts a b i * GeoConstraint.seg pts c e i) = 0
  have hcongr : (∑ i, GeoConstraint.seg (fixSamePoint p q pts) a b i
                       * GeoConstraint.seg (fixSamePoint p q pts) c e i)
              = (∑ i, GeoConstraint.seg pts a b i * GeoConstraint.seg pts c e i) := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    show (fixSamePoint p q pts b i - fixSamePoint p q pts a i)
           * (fixSamePoint p q pts e i - fixSamePoint p q pts c i)
       = (pts b i - pts a i) * (pts e i - pts c i)
    rw [ha, hb, hc, he]
  rw [hcongr]

name: conjMeasure
doc:
**The composite measure**: `samePointMeasure` plus `perpMeasure`. Each is 0 or 1, so the sum is 0 exactly when
both constraints hold -- which is what `atomic` below needs.
stmt: noncomputable def conjMeasure (a b c e p q : ℕ) (pts : ℕ → Pt n) : ℕ
proof: samePointMeasure p q pts + perpMeasure a b c e pts

name: conjMeasure_eq_zero_iff
doc:
**The composite measure is zero exactly when both constraints hold.** A sum of two naturals is zero exactly
when both are.
stmt:
theorem conjMeasure_eq_zero_iff (a b c e p q : ℕ) (pts : ℕ → Pt n) :
    conjMeasure a b c e p q pts = 0
      ↔ pts p = pts q ∧ GeoConstraint.Holds (.perpendicular a b c e) pts
proof:
by
  unfold conjMeasure
  rw [Nat.add_eq_zero_iff, samePointMeasure_eq_zero_iff, perpMeasure_eq_zero_iff]

name: conjRepair
doc:
**Repairing a `samePoint` and a `perpendicular` constraint together.**

The two constraints are repaired in sequence -- first the coincidence, then the perpendicularity -- and the measure is
their sum. That product shape fails in general (`Lattice.Geo.ClosedLoop` records why), and it works here because each
step leaves the other constraint alone:

* `fixSamePoint` writes only at `q`, and `q` avoids all four points the perpendicular constraint reads;
* `fixPerp` writes only at `b`, and `p, q` both avoid `b`.

So after the two steps both constraints hold, the measure is `0`, and the hypothesis that the composite was failing
(`¬ Sat pts`) guarantees it started above `0`.

The hypotheses are therefore not decoration: `q ∉ {a, b, c, e}` is what rules out interference, `p, q ≠ b` is what
rules out the perpendicular step breaking the coincidence, and the remaining non-degeneracy conditions are what the
two individual repairs already required.
stmt:
noncomputable def conjRepair
    (a b c e p q : ℕ)
    (hp : p ≠ b) (hqa : q ≠ a) (hqb : q ≠ b) (hqc : q ≠ c) (hqe : q ≠ e)
    (hab : a ≠ b) (hcb : c ≠ b) (heb : e ≠ b)
    (hv : ∀ pts : ℕ → Pt n,
      (∑ j, (pts e j - pts c j) * (pts e j - pts c j)) ≠ 0) :
    Lattice.Core.Repair (ℕ → Pt n) where
  Sat
proof:
fun pts => pts p = pts q ∧ GeoConstraint.Holds (.perpendicular a b c e) pts
  fix := fun pts => fixPerp a b c e (fixSamePoint p q pts)
  μ := conjMeasure a b c e p q
  absorbs := by
    intro pts h
    show fixPerp a b c e (fixSamePoint p q pts) = pts
    rw [fixSamePoint_absorbs p q pts h.1]
    exact fixPerp_absorbs a b c e pts h.2 (hv pts)
  decreases := by
    intro pts h
                                                                         
    have hs1 : fixPerp a b c e (fixSamePoint p q pts) p
             = fixPerp a b c e (fixSamePoint p q pts) q :=
      fixPerp_preserves_samePoint a b c e (fixSamePoint p q pts) p q hp hqb
        (fixSamePoint_holds p q pts)
    have hs2 : GeoConstraint.Holds (.perpendicular a b c e)
        (fixPerp a b c e (fixSamePoint p q pts)) :=
      fixPerp_holds a b c e (fixSamePoint p q pts) hab hcb heb (hv _)
    have hzero : conjMeasure a b c e p q (fixPerp a b c e (fixSamePoint p q pts)) = 0 :=
      (conjMeasure_eq_zero_iff a b c e p q _).mpr ⟨hs1, hs2⟩
                                                               
    have hpos : conjMeasure a b c e p q pts ≠ 0 := by
      intro hz
      exact h ((conjMeasure_eq_zero_iff a b c e p q pts).mp hz)
    show conjMeasure a b c e p q (fixPerp a b c e (fixSamePoint p q pts))
       < conjMeasure a b c e p q pts
    rw [hzero]
    exact Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hpos
  atomic := by
    intro pts h
    exact (conjMeasure_eq_zero_iff a b c e p q pts).mp h

end Lattice.Geo
